answer: We're open Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 5 PM, and Saturday 9 AM to 1 PM. We're closed on Sundays.
We're at 123 Main Street, Suite 4, right next to the pharmacy. There's free parking behind the building.
We accept most major PPO plans, including Delta Dental, Cigna, Aetna and MetLife. Bring your card and we'll verify your benefits before your visit.
A routine cleaning typically runs $100 to $200 without insurance. Most plans cover it at 100 percent.
Professional in-office whitening is usually $350 to $500, and take-home trays are around $250.
A single implant typically ranges from $3,000 to $5,000 including the crown. The consultation is where we give you an exact quote.
Fillings usually run $150 to $350 depending on size and material.
A root canal typically ranges from $700 to $1,500 depending on the tooth. Insurance often covers a good portion.
Pricing depends on the treatment. For example, cleanings are about $100 to $200 and fillings $150 to $350. We'll give you an exact quote and check your insurance before any work starts.
A cleaning takes about an hour and includes a polish and a check for gum disease. We recommend one every six months.
Yes, we offer in-office whitening, about an hour for a noticeably brighter smile, plus take-home trays.
Implants replace missing teeth with a titanium post and a natural-looking crown. It starts with a consultation and a 3D scan to see if you're a good candidate.
A root canal removes infected tissue inside a tooth to save it. With modern anesthesia it feels much like getting a filling.
Yes, we keep same-day slots for dental emergencies. For severe swelling, trouble breathing or uncontrolled bleeding, call 911 or go to the ER first. I can book an emergency visit for you right now.
Welcome! For a first visit, arrive 15 minutes early with a photo ID and your insurance card. We'll take any X-rays needed and plan your care together.
We offer interest-free payment plans and accept all major cards. You can also pay from your phone using a secure link we text you.
Yes, we welcome children from age 3 and up, with gentle first visits designed to make dentistry fun.
We take comfort seriously. We use numbing gel and local anesthesia, and we offer nitrous oxide for nervous patients. You're always in control and can pause any time.
We ask for 24 hours' notice to cancel or reschedule so we can offer the slot to another patient. There's no fee for your first late cancellation.
We use low-radiation digital X-rays, typically once a year or only when clinically needed.
You'll be seen by Dr. Sarah Khan or Dr. Michael Reed. Both are experienced in general and cosmetic dentistry.
